title: Complete Scalar Resolvent Characterization, Closed-Form Qutrit Boundaries, and Quantum-Coherence Advantage Beyond Blackwell Majorization in Quantum-State Texture
abstract: In the resource theory of quantum-state texture (QST), the unique free state is the flat pure state f_1 = |f_1><f_1| and free operations are CPTP maps satisfying Lambda(f_1) = f_1. Recently, de Leon (arXiv:2611.34865v1) derived a normal form for QST free operations (Theorem 1), reduced deterministic convertibility rho -> sigma in arbitrary dimension D to a (D-1)^2-variable complex semidefinite program (Theorem 2 and Corollary 4), and demonstrated in Section V.D that the two qubit scalar monotones -- geometric texture T_g and texture weight T_w -- fail for D >= 3, leaving higher-dimensional reachability governed numerically by SDPs. We prove that no matrix SDP is needed in any finite dimension D >= 2: deterministic QST convertibility is completely characterized by a single smooth one-parameter family of scalar resolvent monotones c_lambda(rho) := p - x^H (R + lambda I_{D-1})^{-1} x = <f_1|(rho + lambda I_D)^{-1}|f_1>^{-1} - lambda (lambda in (0, infinity)), interpolating smoothly and concavely between maximal free fraction c_0(rho) = 1 - T_w(rho) and normalized grand sum c_infinity(rho) = Sigma(rho)/D = 1 - T_g(rho). First (Theorem 1), via a self-contained simultaneous-congruence-diagonalization proof on the Slater-regular Sylvester Lagrangian, we prove rho -> sigma iff c_lambda(sigma) >= c_lambda(rho) for all lambda > 0 iff ||sigma - t f_1||_1 <= ||rho - t f_1||_1 for all t >= 0, showing every strictly separating witness admits a positive perturbation decomposing into a free-population term plus at most D - 1 finite resolvent evaluations, and reducing convertibility to nonnegativity of a single univariate polynomial of degree at most 2D - 2 on (0, infinity). Second (Theorem 2), for any rank-1-coherence source and target in arbitrary D >= 2, we derive an exact C^1-matched two-regime square-root boundary achieved explicitly by a rank-1 contraction T*, yielding an instant rational scalar obstruction c_{3/20}(sigma) - c_{3/20}(rho) = -3/50 < 0 on de Leon's Section V.D counterexample (Eq. (64)) and replacing de Leon's entire Fig. 3 numerical SDP reachability curves with an exact algebraic formula (matching CLARABEL SDPs to < 5e-9). Third (Theorem 3), we construct a full-rank, purely rational qutrit pair (rho, sigma) with an explicit 4-Kraus QST channel (T = diag(1, 0), strictly positive remainder) where rho -> sigma holds strictly yet classical spectral-measure Blackwell (convex-decreasing) dominance fails by +21/1250 at t = 7/25; we further establish the exact Kraus rank 1 + r_T max(1, r_Delta) with sharp ceiling D on rank-<=1-remainder boundaries (saving (D-1)^2 operators over de Leon's Corollary 3 bound 1 + D(D-1)) and an exact free-state dilution scaling law (giving exact algebraic threshold alpha_min = (8 - sqrt(46))/18 on Eq. (64)). All 18 core algebraic theorems are formally verified in constructive Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 custom axioms), backed by 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
